ALTER TABLE %PREFIX%_statistics ADD COLUMN sta_overview boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS %PREFIX%_statistics_cache ( sca_sta_id integer unsigned NOT NULL, sca_key varchar(64) NOT NULL, sca_data text NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (sca_sta_id), CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_FK_SCA_STA FOREIGN KEY (sca_sta_id) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_statistics (sta_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE ) ENGINE = InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 COLLATE = utf8mb4_unicode_ci

UPDATE %PREFIX%_menu SET men_url = '/plugins/statistics/modules/index.php', men_com_id = (SELECT com_id FROM %PREFIX%_components WHERE com_type = 'PLUGIN' AND com_name_intern = 'statistics') WHERE men_name_intern = 'statistics' AND men_com_id IS NULL

ALTER TABLE %PREFIX%_statistics_columns ADD CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_FK_STC_ROL FOREIGN KEY (stc_role) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_roles (rol_id) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
UPDATE %PREFIX%_statistics_rows SET str_role = NULL WHERE str_role IS NOT NULL AND str_role NOT IN (SELECT rol_id FROM %PREFIX%_roles)
ALTER TABLE %PREFIX%_statistics_rows ADD CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_FK_STR_ROL FOREIGN KEY (str_role) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_roles (rol_id) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
